message.content:
**Image 1 (Desktop 1440px): PASS**
*   Layout is correct: thumbnail on the left, category link + bold title in the center, and price/stepper aligned to the right.
*   No clipping, overflow, or text overlap detected. All elements are properly spaced and legible.

**Image 2 (Mobile 390px): FAIL**
*   **Defect: Aggressive Title Truncation.** The product title "Кукла «Виктория» с гардеробом и 6 нарядами" is truncated too severely, displaying only as "Кукла «Вик...". This makes it difficult for the user to identify the specific item in the sticky bar.
*   **Defect: Category Link Truncation.** The breadcrumb/category text "Все товары: Мо..." is also heavily truncated, losing its context.
*   **Layout Note:** While the layout structure (thumbnail, info, price/stepper) remains intact, the middle section is too compressed, forcing critical information to be hidden.
